verdict.rationale: Gemini documents automations in the form of scheduled recurring actions, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows version history, review workflows, or rollback for those automations. The ability to review prompts and delete activity in My Activity is general activity history, not automation versioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
